verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a SaaS developer tool that manages many corrections and sessions, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no documented way to act on many items at once, such as bulk-activating, editing, rolling back or labeling corrections or sessions. Previewing one correction against stored traces, spotting repeated mistakes across runs, and listing every correction in one place are analysis and management views, not bulk actions. No API is documented either, since every OpenAPI path returned 404.
